facts.business: Edelweiss Financial Services Limited is a diversified financial services company offering alternative asset management, mutual funds, NBFC lending, insurance, and credit/ARC businesses.
key_risks: Impairment of receivables from financing business based on ECL approach involving significant management judgement
Geopolitical uncertainty and macro-economic conditions affecting portfolio performance
Regulatory changes including new Labour Code and GST exemption impacts
Put option obligations on Security Receipts and AIF IRR guarantees
facts.related_party_note: ECap Equities Limited, Edelweiss Investment Adviser Limited, Edelweiss Rural and Corporate Services Limited, ECL Finance Limited, Edelweiss Securities and Investments Private Limited, EAAA Pte. Limited, Edelweiss Life Insurance Company Limited are subsidiaries with related party transactions including loan loss provisions, functional currency changes, and put option arrangements.
